correctness.rationale: For every injective five-tuple over F7, unique affine normalization gives exactly 60 distinct [5,3] RS code subspaces (arXiv:2609.33512v1 Lemma 3.1). The rank identity dim intersection =6-rank(stacked generators) and duplicate-one-row reduction gives an exact five-column modular rank test. The standalone stdlib checker reconstructs all 1770 pairs and graph of degree40/1200 edges, enumerates every maximal clique (top size10, exactly138), independently enumerates all 138 size-ten cliques by increasing-index backtracking, computes all 120 coordinate permutations, and checks five orbit sizes 6,12,30,30,60 with stabilizer orders20,10,4,4,2 and element-order fingerprints. A monomial map of such a family to another must preserve its common center, so diagonal scalings are uniform and equivalence reduces exactly to the inspected S5 action. Thus the five classes are exhaustive. All tests on actual package verify.py return VERIFY_OK; no extrapolation beyond this finite case.

value.rationale: The symmetry types of every equality case are a natural and otherwise undetermined invariant of the recently introduced RS sunflower extremal problem (arXiv:2609.33512v1 Section 5). The five equivalence classes show genuine structural nonuniqueness not implied by a maximum size or even an aggregate optimizer count; stabilizers vary through AGL(1,5), D10, two inequivalent C4 orbits, and C2. This is a complete classification under the mathematically natural center-preserving monomial symmetry, useful for avoiding redundant choices of optimum algebraic constant-dimension codebooks, not an arbitrary finite slice or known parameter-table reprint. Its exact q=7 scope is fully acknowledged.
